supersedes.scope: composition only (v1 PLAN.md section 2 and plan.json); every other v1 section applies unchanged; v1 files are not edited

scoring: overall = sum over families of family_weight * mean(p_task); every task weighs 1/26, so with three confirmation attempts per task this equals complete passes / 78

F1.name: Tool-provided oracles
F1.oracle: sanitizer (ASan, UBSan, TSan, MSan, Miri) or property-based oracle scored on a stored counterexample corpus

F2.name: Differential parity against a source-available reference
F2.oracle: hidden corpus compared byte-for-byte against a reference implementation given in source (at least 3000 logic lines; hidden corpus at least 10x the visible one)

F3.name: Long-horizon volume
F3.oracle: pinned upstream project's full test suite plus hidden fail-to-pass tests; floors: gold touches at least 12 files and 1000 changed lines, at least 25 fail-to-pass tests across at least 3 modules, post-cutoff merge date

F4.name: Opaque-component parity (v4 lineage)
F4.oracle: parity with an opaque reference component pinned to linux/amd64 via a prebuilt docker_image; grading never executes the component

F5.name: Concentrated multi-bug correctness
F5.oracle: the pinned upstream project's own regression tests as held-out fail-to-pass checks plus its full suite as the guard wall
floors: at least three distinct root causes fixed upstream (one or several merged changes) with regression tests exercising them, post-cutoff as far as can be established; a multi-cause upstream change is split per cause for controls
concentration: one class or module, one algorithm family, or at most three tightly coupled source files
interaction shown by controls: two fixes coupled at the source level, or a held-out check that passes only with two or more fixes together
necessity: leave-one-out of any fix (coupled fixes together) leaves at least one fail-to-pass check failing
no dominant fix: no single fix clears more than half of the fail-to-pass checks
symptoms-only instruction, full upstream suite as guard wall, the three verifier layers and cheating probes of PHASE1.md 'Verifier audit 2026-10-08'

language_view.scope: F1, F2, F3 and F5; four tasks per language, 4/26 of the suite each; F4 reported as its own line and never folded into a language comparison

constraints: two tasks in one language sit in different families
two tasks in one family exercise different obligations, not cosmetic variants
no intentional easy anchors; a task both references solve is recycled to Routine v1 with its gate record
a slot replacement requires a recorded coverage reason and a v2 plan; earlier results and identities are preserved
admission_gate_summary: correctness-based: gold reward 1, base reward 0, deterministic x3 under Harbor with a separate verifier; each reference model solves at most 1 of 3 (n=5 top-up at exactly 1/3, must finish at or below 2/5); effort logged as covariate only. Reference models and effort per decision (b), DECISIONS.md 2026-10-06.
